goal: Fixes FillPSBT so wallets sign inputs they own even when a PSBT's witness_utxo and non_witness_utxo disagree
Prevents signing failures caused by a malicious or buggy PSBT coordinator supplying conflicting UTXOs
reviewability: Needs rebase, mergeable state unknown so a review of the current diff may be invalidated once rebased
agreement: Concept approval after author explained the malicious/buggy-coordinator threat model, no further pushback (vicjuma)
Single reviewer engaged and their question was resolved by author's explanation, leaving no unresolved objection

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes a real but narrow correctness bug requiring a malicious or buggy PSBT coordinator
The failure mode is an incomplete signature, not fund loss or a wrong signature, per the author
Comes with regression tests pinning the fix, but the benefit is limited to a specific edge case
